Tickets on sale soon,
all digital platforms
Doors 22:00. Bring ID, leave the coat.

Linden Street
from the bakery
to the old pool
Live bands on the steps, long tables, a swap shop, face painting and a very slow race.
THIS WEEK ONLY  •  THIS WEEK ONLY  •  THIS WEEK ONLY
Every pair in the shop, no exceptions, no code.

Mon to Sat 10 to 19
Storgatan 14, Uppsala

Five ways to make
a small shop feel big
Warm bulbs, one shelf, nothing taped to the glass.
Big numbers, plain words. People walk past small print.
A sign, a smell or a sample. Something to meet them on the step.
Write three names on the board each week. They will bring friends.
End every visit with the next date, a stamp or a small gift.
Short projects with a clear date and a clear mess, finished on time. Forty one of them.
Hire one person who can draw
Say no to every logo sprint
Twice as much cinnamon as you think
Dark, a little burnt on purpose
For people who know what they want
and the coffee is 8 kr cheaper. We wash it. You carry it home.
Allergies? Ask, we will tell you the truth.
A long table above the bakery. We cook, you bring wine and a story about a bad first job.

Message us with
your name and
your allergies.
280 kr, drinks not included. Seats are first come and we will say no kindly.

Saturday 12 April, from 19:00
The roof at Kungsgatan 22
Bring a dish and a dance move

SNACKS
FOR A
LONG
TRAIN
RIDE
Save for the next long trip
